name: Magnavox Odyssey²
description: Magnavox's second-generation console, sold in Europe by parent company Philips as the Videopac G7000. Released in 1978, it stood out with a full membrane keyboard built into the console, used for educational titles, menus and simple programming.

specs.memory: 64 B internal + 128 B external RAM, 128 B A/V RAM

curiosities: European sales were halted after about 7,500 units because of a faulty power plug, and resumed in 1979.
The Voice add-on provided speech synthesis, but unlike Mattel's Intellivoice no game required it.
The Master Strategy Series, such as Quest for the Rings!, combined a video game with a physical board game.
